title: Vitex Pharmaceuticals
description: vitexpharma.com zoominfo.com/c/vitex-pharmaceuticals-pty-ltd/90505264 Vitex Pharmaceuticals is a leading Australian contract manufacturer specializing in vitamins, minerals, and nutritional complementary medicines. Founded in 1989, this wholly Australian-owned company operates one of the country's largest and most state-of-the-art pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities. Recently, the company significantly expanded its capacity by opening a massive $250 million facility in Western Sydney to supply both domestic and global markets
